mapper.insert: INSERT INTO template ( title, canvas_data, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{canvasData}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, canvas_data AS canvasData, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM template ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, title, canvas_data AS canvasData, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM template WHERE id = #{id}
